
```{python}
import polars as pl
```

```{python}
import boto3

session = boto3.Session(profile_name="localstack")
glue = session.client("glue")
s3 = session.client("s3")
```

```{python}
def load_table(table_name, partition_key_value=[]) -> pl.DataFrame:
    table_glue = glue.get_table(
        DatabaseName="catalunya_data_dev",
        Name=table_name,
    )["Table"]

 
    location_s3 = table_glue["StorageDescriptor"]["Location"]
    bucket, prefix = location_s3.removeprefix("s3://").split("/", 1)

    response = s3.list_objects_v2(
        Bucket=bucket,
        Prefix=prefix,
    )

    for obj in response.get("Contents", []):
        print(obj["Key"])

    partition_location_s3 = (
        location_s3
        + "/".join(f"{p}={k}" for p, k in partition_key_value)
        + ("/" if len(partition_key_value) > 0 else "")
    )
    print(partition_location_s3)

    table_parquet_scan = pl.scan_parquet(
        f"{partition_location_s3}*.parquet",
        credential_provider=pl.CredentialProviderAWS(profile_name="localstack"),
    )
    return table_parquet_scan.collect()
```


```{python}

tables = glue.get_tables(
    DatabaseName="catalunya_data_dev"
)
[t['Name'] for t in tables['TableList']]
```

```{python}
muncipal_population_df = load_table("municipal_population")
social_services_df = load_table(
    "social_services", partition_key_value=[("downloaded_date", "20260807")]
).filter(
    pl.col("service_type_id").is_in(
        ["DAY-001", "RES-003", "RES-002", "TUT-001", "RES-001"]
    )
    & (pl.col("capacity") > 0)
)
```
